                     name = c("nasdaq100_io1","nasdaq100_io2","nasdaq100_io3","nasdaq100_io4","nasdaq100_io5"))

  ocean2$Prev = NULL

  abind$Time = sub("^[^ ]* ", "", abind$tradetime)
  abind <<- abind %>% filter(Symbol %in% ocean2$Symbol)
  ocean2 <<- oceanData %>% filter(!Company %in% "BlackBox-i")

  if (counter > 0) {
    counter <<- counter + 1
    abind$Date1 = abindsave$Date
    abind$Time1 = abindsave$Time
    abind$price1 = abindsave$price
    abind$tradetime1 = abindsave$tradetime
    abind$price = ifelse(abind$Time > abind$Time1,abind$price,abind$price1)
    abind$Date = ifelse(abind$Date > abind$Date1,abind$Date,abind$Date1)
    abind$Time = ifelse(abind$Time > abind$Time1,abind$Time,abind$Time1)
    abind$tradetime = ifelse(abind$Time > abind$Time1,abind$tradetime,abind$tradetime1)
  }
  p = place %>% na.omit() %>% group_by(Symbol) %>% slice_max(order_by = Date, n = 1) %>% filter(Symbol %in% unique(oceanData$Sector))
  p = distinct(p,Symbol,.keep_all = TRUE)
  p = p %>% select(Symbol,price = Price)
  abind = bind_rows(abind,p)
  ocean <<- oceanData %>% left_join(abind,by = "Symbol")  
  a = oceanData %>% select(Symbol,Sector)
  ocean$p5d = round(100* (ocean$price - ocean$pr5d)/ocean$pr5d,2)
  ocean$p15d = round(100* (ocean$price - ocean$pr15d)/ocean$pr15d,2)
  ocean$p1m = round(100* (ocean$price - ocean$pr1m)/ocean$pr1m,2)
  ocean$p6m = round(100* (ocean$price - ocean$pr6m)/ocean$pr6m,2)
  ocean$pYTD = round(100* (ocean$price - ocean$prYTD)/ocean$prYTD,2)
  ocean$p1y = round(100* (ocean$price - ocean$pr1y)/ocean$pr1y,2)
  ocean$p3y = round(100* (ocean$price - ocean$pr3y)/ocean$pr3y,2)
  ocean$p5y = round(100* (ocean$price - ocean$pr5y)/ocean$pr5y,2)
  ocean$p10y = round(100* (ocean$price - ocean$pr10y)/ocean$pr10y,2)
  ocean$pBelow = round(100* (ocean$price - ocean$BelowN)/ocean$BelowN,2)
  ocean$pLower = round(100* (ocean$prLower - ocean$price)/ocean$price,2)
  ocean$pUpper = round(100* (ocean$prUpper - ocean$price)/ocean$price,2)
  ocean$pTrend = round(100* (ocean$prTrend - ocean$price)/ocean$price,2)
  ocean$pSince = Sys.Date() - as.Date(ocean$BelowDate)
  ocean$pTarget1yr =  sub('.*[\\(,]', '', ocean$`Target1y.p`)

  ocean$pTarget1yr = str_remove_all(ocean$pTarget1yr,"%")
  ocean$pTarget1yr = gsub("\\+", "", ocean$pTarget1yr)
  ocean$pTarget1yr = ifelse(is.na(ocean$pTarget1yr),0,ocean$pTarget1yr)
  ocean$pTarget1yr = ifelse(ocean$pTarget1yr %in% "n/a",0,ocean$pTarget1yr)
  ocean$pTarget1yr =  as.numeric(ocean$pTarget1yr)
  ocean$pToday = ocean$changepct
  data2 = ocean %>% group_by(Company = Sector) %>% summarise(Symbol = "--",
                                                             p5d = round(mean(p5d),2),
                                                             p15d = round(mean(p15d),2),
                                                             p1m = round(mean(p1m),2),
                                                             p6m = round(mean(p6m),2),
                                                             pYTD = round(mean(pYTD),2),
                                                             p1y = round(mean(p1y),2),
                                                             p3y = round(mean(p3y),2),
                                                             p5y = round(mean(p5y),2),
                                                             
                                                             pSince = round(mean(pSince),2),
                                                             pBelow = round(mean(pBelow),2),
                                                             pTrend = round(mean(pTrend),2),
                                                             pLower = round(mean(pLower),2),
                                                             pUpper = round(mean(pUpper),2),
                                                             pTarget1yr = round(mean(na.omit(pTarget1yr)),2),
                                                             pToday = round(mean(na.omit(pToday)),2)
                                                             
  )
  data2$Sector = data2$Company

  ocean = bind_rows(ocean,data2)
  
  ocean$sBelow = ifelse(ocean$pBelow < 0,paste0("-",-1*ocean$pBelow,"%" ),"Current")

  ocean$sSince = ifelse(ocean$pSince == 0, "Current",ifelse(ocean$pSince < 366,paste0(round(as.numeric(ocean$pSince)/1,1),"d"),

  ocean$s1m = ifelse(ocean$p1m >0,paste0("<font color = 'darkgreen'>",ocean$p1m,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-up"))),
                     paste0("<font color = 'maroon'>",-1*ocean$p1m,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-down"))))
  
  ocean$s6m = ifelse(ocean$p6m >0,paste0("<font color = 'darkgreen'>",ocean$p6m,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-up"))),
                     paste0("<font color = 'maroon'>",-1*ocean$p6m,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-down"))))
  
  ocean$sYTD = ifelse(ocean$pYTD >0,paste0("<font color = 'darkgreen'>",ocean$pYTD,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-up"))),
                      paste0("<font color = 'maroon'>",-1*ocean$pYTD,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-down"))))
  
  ocean$s1y = ifelse(ocean$p1y >0,paste0("<font color = 'darkgreen'>",ocean$p1y,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-up"))),
                     paste0("<font color = 'maroon'>",-1*ocean$p1y,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-down"))))
  
  ocean$s3y = ifelse(ocean$p3y >0,paste0("<font color = 'darkgreen'>",ocean$p3y,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-up"))),
                     paste0("<font color = 'maroon'>",-1*ocean$p3y,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-down"))))
  
  ocean$s5y = ifelse(ocean$p5y >0,paste0("<font color = 'darkgreen'>",ocean$p5y,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-up"))),
                     paste0("<font color = 'maroon'>",-1*ocean$p5y,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-down"))))
  
  ocean$s10y = ifelse(ocean$p10y >0,paste0("<font color = 'darkgreen'>",ocean$p10y,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-up"))),
                      paste0("<font color = 'maroon'>",-1*ocean$p10y,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-down"))))
  
  ocean$sTarget1yr= ifelse(ocean$pTarget1yr>0,paste0("<font color = 'darkgreen'>",ocean$pTarget1yr,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-up"))),
                           paste0("<font color = 'maroon'>",-1*ocean$pTarget1yr,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-down"))))
  ocean$sTarget1yr = ifelse(ocean$sTarget1yr == paste0("<font color = 'maroon'>0%",as.character(icon("arrow-down"))),"",ocean$sTarget1yr )
  
  ocean$pRatings = ifelse(ocean$`Rating.p` == "Strong Buy",2,ifelse(ocean$`Rating.p` == "Buy",1,0))
  ocean$sRating = ifelse(ocean$`Rating.p` == "Strong Buy","Strong",ocean$`Rating.p`)
  ocean$sRating = ifelse(ocean$sRating %in% NA,"",ocean$sRating)
  ocean$Date1 = as.Date(sub(" .*", "", ocean$tradetime),"%m/%d/%Y")
  ocean$Time = sub("^[^ ]* ", "", ocean$tradetime)
  ocean1 = ocean

  c = c %>% slice_min(order_by = Date,n = 1)
  c = c %>% select(Symbol, pclose = Price)
  b = ocean %>% select(price,Sector) %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(Sector) %>% summarise(price = sum(price))
  b$Symbol = b$Sector
  d = ocean %>% filter(Symbol %in% c(b$Symbol))
  d = d %>% left_join(c, by = "Symbol")
  d$pToday = NULL
  d$pToday = round(100*((d$price - d$pclose) / d$pclose),2)
  ocean = ocean %>% filter(!Symbol %in% d$Symbol)
  ocean = bind_rows(ocean,d)
